summary.name: Telo
summary.one_liner: Telo is an iPhone and Apple Watch health coach app that syncs sleep, HRV, and workouts from Apple Health to show daily readiness and recovery, with optional read-only AI assistant access via MCP.
keywords: ask ai about my health data
use_cases: review sleep and HRV trends against a personal baseline
ask an AI assistant about recent sleep and workouts
correlate logged events like busy weeks with recovery
track workouts and recovery in one place
summary.what_it_does:
Telo reads sleep, heart rate variability (HRV), and workout data from Apple Health with the user's permission, and combines it into a daily readiness score that compares recovery, sleep, and workout load to the user's usual baseline. It also shows synced workouts and sleep next to meals, stress, and daily events the user logs by voice, photo, or text. Users can connect Telo to Claude Desktop or, once the listing is approved, ChatGPT, to ask questions about their synced sleep, activity, scores, and health log. The page says Telo provides general wellness information only, not diagnosis or treatment.</what_it_does>
